findings.description: The KMS key does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation is unset, defaulting to false), so the same cryptographic key material protects the audit bucket indefinitely. A non-rotated, long-lived key increases the volume of data protected by a single key and the impact if that key material is ever compromised or exposed.

No key policy is attached to this KMS key, so AWS applies the default key policy, which grants kms:* on all resources to the account root principal and delegates access broadly through IAM. Access to this audit data key is therefore not scoped to the intended use case as required by least privilege.
